newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends slightly weaker.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends slightly weaker.

text.p: Price movements remained narrow up to the close on the white sugar futures market on Monday as trading the nearby December/March spread boosted total volume.
Activity was generally quiet but the volume was boosted by broker and commission house selling of the spread and some crosses were also seen, traders said.
At the close, the December contract was $0.30 firmer at $322.40 having dipped to a low of $321.20 earlier and trading 770 lots.
The March contract accounted for 1,231 lots and closed flat at $318.10.
Last week the second-month March contract took over the main market interest when open interest overtook that of December.
Some outright March trades were also reported and the position accounted for the bulk of the overall volume.
Paris activity was lacklustre with only three contracts trading.
December was down 40 cents at $322.00 and March down 90 cents at $317.80. Matif volume totalled 434 lots.
